name: LayerFilterThemes
description: Theme rail for the two-step layer filter (step 1). Configures its own theme list and owns the selection; pair it with a panel plugin (LayerFilter, or a swap-in) whose theme ids match. Also carries a chevron that opens/closes a neighbouring panel. Events — emits: plugin:layerfilterthemes:selectedThemeChanged { themeId, initial? }. Requests: tool:getVars, panels:getAll, panels:toggleCollapsed.

components.name: Default theme
components.description: Theme id selected on load. Falls back to the first theme when it matches nothing.

components.name: Panel to open/close
components.description: Id of the panel the rail's chevron opens and closes. Leave blank to drive the rail's neighbour — the one other collapsible panel in the same region; the chevron is hidden when that is ambiguous or the named panel doesn't exist.

components.name: Themes
components.description: One row per category on the rail, top to bottom. Each row's Theme Id must match a theme id in the paired filter panel's config — that id is what the rail broadcasts on selection. Pick where the row's icon comes from, then fill in the matching field; an icon is drawn in the rail's own colors whichever source it came from.

object.name: Theme Id
object.description: Must match the filter panel's theme id.

object.name: Label
object.description: Shown under the icon. Falls back to the id.

object.name: Icon Source
object.description: Which of the three fields below supplies this row's icon.

object.name: Upload Icon
object.description: An SVG or PNG for this category. Drawn as a silhouette in the rail's colors, so a single-color glyph on a transparent background works best.

object.name: Icon Link
object.description: URL of an icon hosted elsewhere.

object.name: MDI Icon Name
object.description: A Material Design Icons name without the 'mdi-' prefix, e.g. 'flash-outline'.
